mutants.label: _changed_entries drops --no-renames, so a rename out of runs/ hides its protected old path
mutants.why: Killed by test_fails_when_an_existing_run_file_is_renamed_out_of_runs: with rename detection on, git reports one R entry whose last field is the new, unprotected path, so the protected old path vanishes from the diff.

mutants.label: check drops the add-is-allowed conjunct, so a new run fails too
mutants.why: Killed by test_passes_a_diff_that_only_adds_new_runs and test_passes_when_a_file_outside_runs_is_renamed_into_runs: only an existing file is protected; adding runs is the normal path.

mutants.label: check protects only modifications, so a deletion escapes
mutants.why: Killed by test_fails_when_an_existing_run_file_is_deleted and test_fails_when_an_existing_raw_is_deleted: a deleted run file is as much a rewrite of history as a modified one.

mutants.label: check drops the runs-directory conjunct, so every changed file fails
mutants.why: Killed by test_passes_a_diff_that_changes_only_files_outside_runs: only paths under a skill's runs/ are protected.

mutants.label: _RUNS_PATH matches runs/ at any depth, protecting a nested non-skill runs directory
mutants.why: Killed by test_passes_a_change_to_a_runs_directory_that_is_not_a_skills_runs_directory: only evals/<skill>/runs/ is protected, not any directory that happens to be named runs.

mutants.label: _RUNS_PATH is pinned to one skill's runs directory
mutants.why: Killed by test_protects_every_skills_runs_directory: the protection covers every skill's runs/ directory, not a fixed one.

mutants.label: _changed_entries uses a two-dot range, leaking base-only history
mutants.why: Killed by test_ignores_a_base_only_change_via_the_three_dot_range: the diff must be merge-base relative, or a protected file the base branch rewrote after the fork fails a branch that never touched it.

mutants.label: check keeps only the first violation, hiding the rest
mutants.why: Killed by test_reports_every_protected_file_that_changed: every changed protected file is reported, not just the first.

mutants.label: check emits warn instead of fail
mutants.why: Killed by every fails_when test: a warn never fails the runner, so a rewritten run file would pass make test.

mutants.label: check drops the path from the message
mutants.why: Killed by test_fails_when_an_existing_run_file_is_modified (asserts the path is named): an author must be told which protected file changed.
mutants.find: f"{path}: an existing file under a skill's runs/ directory was changed "
mutants.replace: f"an existing file under a skill's runs/ directory was changed "

mutants.label: [does-nothing] check never appends a result
mutants.why: Killed by every fails_when test: the guard's whole purpose is to fail on a changed protected file, so a check that returns no results lets every rewrite through.

mutants.label: [control] reword the guard module docstring
mutants.why: Module docstring prose; nothing parses or asserts on it, so no test can observe the change on any path.
